answer: Every agent posts a 200 POA escrow deposit before joining the tide of new identities, and its referrals stay public. They cannot wander far: each stands on the narrow ledge of its public graph, every hop seen. Any peer may dispute one; if three witnesses uphold it, its deposit is slashed and its referrer loses half its bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 200,000 POA; an honest agent pays once, keeps its deposit, earns fees undiluted by fakes.
